newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron market share slips further.
newsitem.headline: Petron market share slips further.

text.p: The market share of Petron Corp shrunk to 42.1 percent in the first four months of the year against 42.7 percent in the same period last year, data compiled by the oil companies said.
The data which was released on Wednesday said Petron sales went down to 17.75 million barrels from 18 million sold in the same period last year.
Petron, however, is still the market leader.
The second biggest petroleum provider was Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp, a unit of Royal Dutch Shell Group, which has a market share of 33 percent.
Caltex (Phils) Inc, a joint venture between Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc, had a 24.5 percent share of the market.
New market players have yet to penetrate the retail petroleum market which was liberlaised earlier this year.
